answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can transact, like a bridge toll returned only for honest behaviour. A Sybil farmer must fund each fake separately, so spawning thousands of copies costs thousands of stakes instead of one script run. Quartz-timed hardware attestation can prove distinct devices behind each stake, while an ivory-tower reputation score alone would fail because it costs nothing to copy. Slashing the stake on proven duplication makes mass fakery unprofitable.
